title: Sell Mineral Rights in Fellsburg, PA
metaTitle: Sell Mineral Rights in Fellsburg, PA
metaDescription: Mineral owner near Fellsburg, Westmoreland County? We buy oil, gas, and royalty interests around New Stanton and the Route 30 corridor. No obligation to talk.
heroLead: Fellsburg is barely a dot on the map near New Stanton, but the farmland around it has been quietly leased and re-leased through three different eras of Pennsylvania gas drilling.
intro: Small unincorporated communities like Fellsburg don't usually have their own courthouse or recorder's office, so title work here almost always runs through Greensburg. That's not a problem for us — it's simply where we start when a Fellsburg-area owner reaches out.
We buy producing royalty interests, leased mineral acreage, and fractional interests inherited from family land near Fellsburg and the broader New Stanton and Route 30 corridor.

sections.heading: A quiet corner of the Westmoreland Marcellus footprint
paragraphs: This part of Westmoreland County has seen steady but not dense Marcellus development compared to the wet-gas core further southwest. Tracts near Fellsburg are more often folded into larger pooled units with neighboring farms than developed as standalone leases, which is common in this transitional part of the play.

sections.heading: Layered deeds from farm and coal history
paragraphs: Land around here changed hands through farm sales and coal-era severances for over a century, so it's not unusual for a Fellsburg tract's oil and gas rights to trace back through several owners before landing with the family selling today. We do the chain-of-title work as part of any purchase.

sections.heading: What we look at before making an offer
paragraphs: Whether your interest is producing, under lease but undrilled, or open, we look at the actual lease terms, well activity nearby, and decline behavior on any producing wells before naming a number.
If you're not sure what you have, that's fine — bring the paperwork and we'll help make sense of it.

faqs.question: Fellsburg isn't a big town — do you still buy mineral rights there?
faqs.answer: Yes. We buy interests in unincorporated communities across Westmoreland County just as readily as in the bigger boroughs; size of the town has no bearing on whether we're interested in the underlying mineral interest.

faqs.question: How do you handle title work for land near Fellsburg since it's unincorporated?
faqs.answer: We pull records through the Westmoreland County Recorder of Deeds in Greensburg, the same office that covers this area regardless of which small community the land sits near.

faqs.question: Can you buy a fractional interest I inherited near Fellsburg?
faqs.answer: Yes, fractional interests split among heirs are common on family farmland in this part of the county, and we regularly buy one owner's share independent of what other heirs decide to do.
